items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: We sent those pictures of Howard Jacob was supposed to use them in the paper

ctx.x: We sent those pictures of Howard Jacob was supposed to use them in the paper, and then I think somebody sent it. That's what you want to see. Less than nothing.
Buzzy Willow's in the orchestra, well I'm going to tell you. It says, this is from the Times picking in October the 26th, it looks like. Oh, yeah. 1931.
